 Judgment

Claimants in M.V.C.No.594 of 2018 on the file of the Senior Civil Judge and MACT, Afzalpur have filed this appeal challenging the judgment and award passed in the said case dated 13.08.2019 claiming for enhancement of compensation.
2. The present appeal is posted for hearing on admission and with the consent on both the sides, the matter is taken up for final disposal.
3. For the sake of convenience, the parties herein are referred to, as per their ranking before the Tribunal.
4. It is the case of the claimants that on 16.11.2016 at about 3,30 p.m., the deceased viz., Kherba netke was going by walk at side of the road.
Near Javahar Mill on Barasi-Solapur Road at Barasi, he met with an accident due to rash and negligent driving of the Car bearing Reg.No.MH No.13/AC-9723 by its driver.
Due to the impact, the deceased sustained grievous injuries and succumbed to the said injuries.
The claimants are his wife and children.

They NC:
2023:KHC-K:5642-DB were depending upon the earning of the deceased.
With these reasons, they prayed to award compensation of Rs.25 Lakhs.
5. The Respondents denied contention of the claimants and has prayed to dismiss the claim petition.
6. From the rival contentions of the parties, the Tribunal had framed necessary issues.
7. The claimants have examined PW-1 and got marked Exs.P1 to P8.

And Respondent No.2 got marked Ex.R1.
8.

After hearing both the parties, appreciating pleadings and evidence, the Tribunal has awarded following amount of compensation:
 Sl.

No . Particulars Amount  (Rs.)
 1. Loss of dependency 5,31,972  2. Loss of consortium 10,000
3 . Loss of love and affection 50,000
4. Loss of estate 10,000  5. Funeral and Transportation 10,000
9. We have heard the arguments.

3 10. The learned Advocate for the claimant has submitted that the Tribunal has not followed principle of law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of NATIONAL INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED Vs. PRANAY SETHI AND OTHERS1 for awarding compensation towards loss of consortium, loss of estate and funeral expenses.

entities.text: NATIONAL INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED Vs. PRANAY SETHI AND OTHERS1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, the Tribunal has awarded lesser amount of compensation under the said head and prayed to enhance the same.
11. The learned Advocate for Respondent No.2/Insurer submits that the Tribunal has properly awarded the compensation amount and it does not call for any interference.

12. The following point emerges for our determination:
"Whether the claimants are entitled for enhancement of compensation?"
13.
Fact of accident and death of husband of claimant No.1 by name Kherba Netke is not in dispute.
Claimants are not disputing the amount of compensation under the head 'loss of dependency'.
The Tribunal has properly appreciated the evidence and awarded just compensation under the said head.

14. In the case of PRANAY SETHI (stated supra) and MAGMA GENERAL INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED VS. NANU RAM ALIAS CHUHRU RAM AND OTHERS2, the Hon'ble Supreme Court held that each claimants are entitled for Rs.40,000/- under the head 'loss of consortium'.

entities.text: MAGMA GENERAL INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED VS. NANU RAM ALIAS CHUHRU RAM AND OTHERS2
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In this case, there are five claimants.
Therefore, claimants are entitled for Rs.2 Lakhs towards loss of consortium.
Under the conventional heads, claimants are entitled for Rs.15,000/- each under the head 'loss of estate' and 'funeral expenses'.
claimants are entitled for enhancement of compensation of Rs.1,50,000/-.
15. Claimant No.1 is the wife of the deceased died during the pendency of this appeal.
The appeal is nothing but continuation of original proceedings.

Therefore, even 2 (2018) 18 SCC 130 NC:
2023:KHC-K:5642-DB though she has died during the pendency of the claim petition, her entitlement to claim just compensation cannot be denied.
16. For the aforesaid discussion, we answer the above point in the 'affirmative' and pass the following:
ORDER The appeal is partly allowed with costs.

The impugned judgment and award passed by the Senior Civil Judge and MACT, Afzalpur in M.V.C.No.594/2018 dated 13.08.2019 is modified as under:
Padmini W/O Kherba Netke Since Deceased ... vs Narayan And Anr on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55636846/
4
a) Claimants are entitled for enhancement of Rs.1,50,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousand only) with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till its payment.
b) Respondent No.2 shall deposit the said amount within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
During the pendency of the appeal, claimant No.1 has died and other claimants are her son and daughters.
Therefore, all of them are entitled for equal share in the enhanced amount of compensation.
The enhanced amount is meager.
Therefore, the entire amount of compensation shall be released in favour of the claimants on due identification.
